name: Chagatai Khanate
description: Raise horses, field mounted and foot troops, and develop the cities and pasturelands of Central Asia.
bonuses: Horses and Pastures: Start with five Horses. Horse Pastures breed additional Horses for mounts or Food.
Mounted Warfare: Eligible units can mount and dismount. Mounted training uses an idle Horse within 32 metres or costs 80 extra Gold.
Steppe Hearths: House your population and research technologies that improve Villager gathering.
Horse Breeding: Research Horse Husbandry for faster breeding and Selective Breeding for more Horse health.
Trade and Horse Imports: Markets and Almaliq Market import Horses. The Market trains both Foot and Mounted Traders.
Yam Logistics: Research Yam Logistics to increase movement speed for all land units by 5%.
Landmark Choices: Choose between trade, military and horse economy landmarks. Ili can breed War Horses or Fattened Horses.
